scope: Second lexical pass: 31 dictionary additions, no analyzer or WASM changes. Target occurrence recognition is not paragraph F1. Selection used fixed and raw validation outcomes.

method.discovery: SHA256 file order: 500 written files and 24 online files; online <=40 documents/file; exclude previous case and preexposed documents; SHA256 document content salted split, modulo5==0 held evaluation (no predictions inspected); <=8 paragraphs/doc, 45..800 chars in SHA256 ID order. Kiwi 0.23.0 num_workers2 nominates nouns only; no gold assertion. Dictionary filter excludes noun frequency>=7; source counts apply sampled discovery only.

shortlist_review.screening_scope: All1196 displayed lexemes screened for atomic domain/loanword or clear proper-name suitability. Non-advanced types were not fully context-annotated; many are Korean compounds, source typos, annotation chunks, adverbs nominated as nouns, Korean names or one-off fictional names. No blanket NNP list promoted.

sample_quality.right_boundary_filter: Only complete word followed by non-Hangul or enumerated particle/copula/derivation; reject longer ingredient/product tokens such as 나이아신아마이드 or 리무버블. Conservative sample eligibility only, not gold tagging.
sample_quality.scope: Collector snapshot before candidate-model evaluation: No evaluation predictions generated/inspected. Raw expanded_contexts retains duplicate rows; final sample JSONL excludes old exact paragraphs and evaluation text duplicated in any discovery paragraph, plus duplicate text within word/split. Fixed gold/spoken and previous reranker exact overlap filtering remains parent task.

method.scope: Kiwi nominated words, then source contexts were reviewed. Expected word/POS tags are targeted annotations, not full source gold. Cases use complete source paragraphs <=1000 characters. Explicit target offsets exclude embedded compounds. Post-selection validation; beta-methasone has no separate evaluation document. No claim of paraphrase/author or pretraining independence.

frequency_scope: Frequencies25,50,100,200,400,800,1600 mapped with Section9 max_freq1444128 and rounded u16 qfreq. Previous six tested normal and no-swap (margin1e30 preserving k10). No normal tested frequency repaired all target/context pairs. Direct FST edits matched decompressed canonical builder output. Fixed candidate availability does not prove an entire lattice upper bound.

benchmark_scope: Same original native binary for both models. Native times include only Analyzer.analyze; Node24/WASM times include JS API and result conversion.
